registration: First successful post-merge production execution; starts with actual decision clock, never backdated
hypothesis: A pair-specific, evidence-labelled news policy which retains high-impact calendar blackouts and primary official HIGH headline review, but does not hard-veto a pair solely due to unknown official-feed coverage or broad third-party headline tags, may increase realistic forward paper fills without worsening cost-stressed expectancy.
same_market_technicals: Reuse byte-identical simple-shadow-v2 propose/replay/position limits; source and all 10 liquid pairs identical. Only news gate differs.
blackout: Calendar must be fresh and available; high-impact currency event blackout preserved; direct primary official HIGH headlines for the affected pair within 3h block proposals.
uncertain_news: Missing primary coverage, unsupported official-feed currency, and global/third-party headlines are flagged UNVERIFIED and remain paper-only. Never claim cleared for Pepperstone manual signals.
execution: NEXT completed M15 candle beyond immutable trigger, later actual OANDA bid/ask observation, 60s response, subsequent M15 open and realistic price chase, gap/ambiguous bars unscored, existing 0.25+0.15pip per-side additional cost stress.
limits: Existing paper portfolio maximum 3 concurrent positions, 2 per currency, 1 per pair per setup; no orders.
suspension: After at least 5 independent scored pair/London-days, a drawdown of >= 5 net illustrative R from the running peak triggers a sticky suspension of NEW paper registrations. Existing paper positions remain monitored; no automatic reset or live promotion.
evaluation: Compare only contemporaneous paired independent pair/London-days against untouched simple-v2 and existing champion; track pending/expired, missed triggers, data gaps, adverse and favourable exits. Treat statistical inference as insufficient until >=20 distinct sessions and >=100 independent scored pair-days and separately reviewed outcomes.
notes: No arbitrary green-trade quota. Relaxed filter is a test hypothesis, never evidence of a profitable edge.
